lead_raw_text:
The structure of LiHg crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6₃/mmc (No. 194), with a unit cell containing four atoms (Li₂Hg₂) and two independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows both Li and Hg centers with 12 geometric neighbors in close-packed-like local arrangements; Li is surrounded by 12 Hg atoms and Hg by 4 Hg and 8 Li atoms, with neighbor distances ranging from about 3.11 to 3.57 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3D-connected component spanning all four sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis identifies corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among 12-vertex Hg polyhedra, and corner- and edge-sharing between Hg and Li polyhedra.
